Today we introduce Plato: the ring for near-silent speech.

We speak faster than we write. But we can’t always say out loud what we’re thinking.

Plato turns thought into action.

Dictate. Transform. Delegate.

Order now: https://plato.it.com. Limited supply.

links.title: Plato Ring | Plato
links.description: From thought to action, at your fingertips. Explore Plato Ring in Silver, Gold, Rosé, and Stealth finishes.
links.text:
Dictate
Turn your voice into polished writing.
Press and hold the portal. “Can we meet around 10?” appears word by word, then becomes a message.
Turn your voice into polished writing.
Press and hold the portal. “Can we meet around 10?” appears word by word, then becomes a message.
Select text. Say what to change.
Select a passage, double tap the portal, and say “Make it shorter.” The paragraph becomes “Can we meet at 10? My afternoon is full.”
Send a task to your personal AI.
Triple tap the portal and say “Prep tomorrow’s meeting.” ChatGPT receives the request and replies “I’m doing it.”
The hardware
A continuous curve. A subtle sheen.
Four tones, each with its own character.

Choose your ringChoose a finish.
The software
Dictate your thoughts. Talk to your agents all at once.
On mobile
Coming soon
First batch ships in December.
Plato Ring lets you use your voice and simple gestures to dictate a message, edit selected text, or delegate a task to an AI assistant.
Press and hold to dictate. Double tap to give an editing command for selected text. Triple tap to delegate a task to your AI assistant.
Plato comes in US sizes 7–13. Select “I need a sizing kit” when you pre-order, and a sizing kit is included. Try it on and confirm your size before your ring ships.
